text: The _Ethics_ of Aristotle is one half of a single treatise of which his _Politics_ is the other half.
zh: 亚里士多德的《伦理学》是一篇论文的一半，而他的《政治学》是另一半。
chunks: The _Ethics_
of Aristotle is one half
of a single treatise
of which his _Politics_ is the other half.

text: In the two works taken together we have their author’s whole theory of human conduct or practical activity, that is, of all human activity which is not directed merely to knowledge or truth.
zh: 在这两部作品中，我们看到了作者关于人类行为或实践活动的整个理论，即所有不仅仅针对知识或真理的人类活动的理论。
chunks: In the two works taken together we have their author’s whole theory
of human conduct or practical activity, that is,
of all human activity
which is not directed merely
to knowledge or truth.

text: Not much can be gathered from their titles, which in any case were not given to them by their author.
zh: 从他们的书名中我们无法得知太多信息，无论如何，这些书名都不是作者给他们的。
chunks: Not much can be gathered
from their titles,
which in any case were not given
to them
by their author.

text: Each of these groups falls into sub-groups which roughly correspond to the several books in each work.
zh: 这些组中的每一组都分为大致对应于每部作品中的几本书的子组。
chunks: Each of these groups falls
into sub-groups which roughly correspond to the several books in each work.

text: Philosophy, nor again that the one deals with the moral activity of the individual and the other with that of the State, nor once more that the one gives us the theory of human conduct, while the other discusses its application in practice, though not all of these misinterpretations are equally erroneous.
chunks: Philosophy, nor again that the one deals with the moral activity of the individual
and the other with that of the State, nor once more
that the one gives us the theory
of human conduct, while the other discusses its application
in practice, though not all of these misinterpretations are equally erroneous.

text: Especially he has investigated the various admirable forms of human character and the mode of their production.
zh: 他特别研究了人类性格的各种令人钦佩的形式及其产生方式。
chunks: Especially he has investigated the various admirable forms
of human character and the mode of their production.

text: We must, however, remember that the production of good character is not the end of either individual or state action: that is the aim of the one and the other because good character is the indispensable condition and chief determinant of happiness, itself the goal of all human doing.
chunks: We must, however, remember that the production of good character is not the end
of either individual or state action: that is the aim
of the one and the other
because good character is the indispensable condition and chief determinant of happiness,
itself the goal of all human doing.

text: This does not mean simply that the State exists to secure in larger measure the objects of degree which the isolated individual attempts, but is too feeble, to secure without it.
zh: 这并不仅仅意味着国家的存在是为了在更大程度上确保孤立的个人试图实现的某种程度的目标，但如果没有国家，国家的存在就太无力了。
chunks: This does not mean simply
that the State exists to secure
in larger measure the objects of degree
which the isolated individual attempts,
but is too feeble, to secure without it.

text: Looking forward, then, to the life of the State as that which aids support, and combines the efforts of the individual to obtain happiness, Aristotle draws no hard and fast distinction between the spheres of action of Man as individual and Man as citizen.
chunks: Looking forward, then, to the life of the State as that
which aids support, and combines the efforts
of the individual to obtain happiness, Aristotle draws no hard
and fast distinction between the spheres of action of Man
as individual and Man as citizen.

text: It discusses especially those admirable human qualities which fit a man for life in an organised civic community, which makes him “a good citizen,” and considers how they can be fostered or created and their opposites prevented.
zh: 它特别讨论了那些令人钦佩的人类品质，这些品质适合一个人在有组织的公民社区中生活，使他成为“好公民”，并考虑如何培养或创造这些品质以及如何防止它们的反面。
chunks: It discusses especially those admirable human qualities
which fit a man for life in an organised civic community,
which makes him “a good citizen,
” and considers how they can be fostered
or created and their opposites prevented.

text: Metaphysics is elaborated, and only so much is brought forward as appears necessary to put the main facts in their proper perspective and setting.
zh: 形而上学得到了详尽的阐述，并且仅提出了将主要事实置于适当的视角和背景下所必需的内容。
chunks: Metaphysics is elaborated, and only
so much is brought forward
as appears necessary
to put the main facts
in their proper perspective and setting.

text: As was pointed out above, the proem (Book I., cc. i-iii.) is a prelude to the treatment of the whole subject covered by the _Ethics_ and the _Politics_ together.
zh: 正如上面所指出的，序言（第一卷，抄送 i-iii.）是处理“伦理学”和“政治学”所涵盖的整个主题的前奏。
chunks: As was pointed out above,
the proem (Book I.,
cc. i-iii.) is a prelude to the treatment
of the whole subject covered
by the _Ethics_ and the _Politics_ together.

text: exactness,” in precision of statement, and closeness of logical concatenation.
zh: 精确性”，即语句的精确性和逻辑连接的紧密性。
chunks: exactness,
” in precision
of statement,
and closeness
of logical concatenation.

text: There are general principles at work in it, and these can be formulated in “rules,” which rules can be systematised or unified.
zh: 其中有一般原则在起作用，这些原则可以用“规则”来表述，这些规则可以系统化或统一。
chunks: There are general principles
at work in it,
and these can be formulated in “rules,
” which rules can be systematised
or unified.

text: Aristotle here holds the balance between a misleading hope of reducing the subject-matter of conduct to a few simple rigorous abstract principles, with conclusions necessarily issuing from them, and the view that it is the field of operation of inscrutable forces acting without predictable regularity.
chunks: Aristotle here holds the balance between a misleading hope
of reducing the subject-matter of conduct to a few simple rigorous abstract principles,
with conclusions necessarily issuing from them, and the view
that it is the field
of operation of inscrutable forces acting without predictable regularity.

text: The mere intellectual apprehension of them is not possible, or if possible, profitless.
zh: 仅仅从智力上理解它们是不可能的，或者即使可能也是无益的。
chunks: The mere intellectual apprehension
of them is not possible,
or if possible, profitless.

text: This is the Greek way of expressing that all human life involves an ideal element—something which it is not yet and which under certain conditions it is to be.
zh: 这是希腊语的表达方式，即所有人类生活都包含一个理想的元素——它还不是，但在某些条件下它将成为的东西。
chunks: This is the Greek way of expressing
that all human life involves an ideal element—
something which it is not yet and
which under certain conditions it is
to be.

text: Moral Philosophy upon the necessity of knowledge as a condition of the best life.
zh: 道德哲学认为知识的必要性是最好生活的条件。
chunks: Moral Philosophy
upon the necessity of knowledge as a condition of the best life.

text: From the outset it is identified with the object of desire, of what we not merely judge desirable but actually do desire, or that which would, if realised, satisfy human desire.
zh: 从一开始，它就等同于欲望的对象，即我们不仅认为是可取的，而且实际上是欲望的东西，或者是如果实现了就会满足人类欲望的东西。
chunks: From the outset it is identified
with the object of desire,
of what we not merely judge desirable
but actually do desire, or that which would,
if realised, satisfy human desire.

text: On the other hand, he rejects his master Plato’s conception of a good which is the end of the whole universe, or at least dismisses it as irrelevant to his present enquiry.
zh: 另一方面，他拒绝了他的老师柏拉图关于整个宇宙的终结的善的概念，或者至少认为它与他目前的探究无关。
chunks: On the other hand,
he rejects his master Plato’s conception
of a good which is the end
of the whole universe, or at least dismisses it
as irrelevant to his present enquiry.

text: The last is the prime condition of successful living and therefore of satisfaction, but Aristotle does not ignore other conditions, such as length of life, wealth and good luck, the absence or diminution of which render happiness not impossible, but difficult of attainment.
chunks: The last is the prime condition
of successful living and therefore of satisfaction,
but Aristotle does not ignore other conditions, such as length of life,
wealth and good luck, the absence or diminution
of which render happiness not impossible, but difficult of attainment.

text: He wavers between belief in its general attainability and an absence of hopefulness.
zh: 他在相信其总体可实现性和缺乏希望之间摇摆不定。
chunks: He wavers
between belief in its general attainability and an absence of hopefulness.

text: Tis in ourselves that we are thus or thus” But once more this does not involve an artificial or abstract isolation of the individual moral agent from his relation to other persons or things from his context in society and nature, nor ignore the relative dependence of his life upon a favourable environment.
chunks: Tis in ourselves that we are thus or thus”
But once more this does not involve an artificial
or abstract isolation of the individual moral agent from his relation to other persons or things
from his context in society and nature, nor ignore the relative dependence
of his life upon a favourable environment.

text: These last fall into two groups, which Aristotle distinguishes as Goodnesses of Intellect and Goodnesses of Character.
zh: 最后这些分为两类，亚里士多德将其区分为智力的善良和品格的善良。
chunks: These last fall
into two groups,
which Aristotle distinguishes
as Goodnesses of Intellect
and Goodnesses of Character.

text: They form the chief or central subject-matter of the _Ethics_.
zh: 它们构成了《伦理学》的主要或中心主题。
chunks: They form the chief
or central subject-matter of the _Ethics_.

text: Aristotle deals with these questions in the reverse order.
zh: 亚里士多德以相反的顺序处理这些问题。
chunks: Aristotle deals
with these questions in the reverse order.

text: Hence the several acts which determine goodness or badness of character must be done in a certain way, and thus the formation of good character requires discipline and direction from without.
zh: 因此，决定品格好坏的几种行为必须以某种方式进行，因此良好品格的形成需要来自外部的纪律和指导。
chunks: Hence the several acts which determine goodness or badness
of character must be done
in a certain way, and thus the formation
of good character requires discipline
and direction from without.

text: The process is one of assimilation, largely by imitation and under direction and control.
zh: 这个过程是一种同化过程，主要是通过模仿并受到指导和控制。
chunks: The process is one
of assimilation,
largely by imitation
and under direction
and control.

text: In the first place, they are those that conform to a rule—to the right rule, and ultimately to reason.
zh: 首先，他们是那些遵守规则的人——遵守正确的规则，并最终遵守理性。
chunks: In the first place,
they are those that conform
to a rule—
to the right rule,
and ultimately to reason.

text: To this adjustment he gives a quantitative interpretation.
zh: 对于这一调整，他给出了定量的解释。
chunks: To this adjustment he
gives a quantitative interpretation.

text: The rule prescribes the control and regulation within limits of the agent’s natural impulses to act and feel thus and thus.
zh: 该规则规定了在代理人采取行动和感受的自然冲动范围内的控制和调节。
chunks: The rule prescribes the control
and regulation within limits
of the agent’s natural impulses
to act and feel thus
and thus.

text: There is no attempt to reduce the rich possibilities of right action to a single monotonous type.
zh: 没有试图将正确行动的丰富可能性简化为单一单调的类型。
chunks: There is no attempt
to reduce the rich possibilities of right action to a single monotonous type.

text: Aristotle tries to show that this is the case in regard to every virtue named and recognised as such, but his treatment is often forced and the endeavour is not very successful.
zh: 亚里士多德试图表明，对于每一种被命名和承认的美德来说都是如此，但他的治疗常常是被迫的，而且这种努力并不是很成功。
chunks: Aristotle tries to show that this is the case
in regard to every virtue named
and recognised as such,
but his treatment is often forced
and the endeavour is not very successful.

text: What we find is a sort of portrait-gallery of the various types of moral excellence which the Greeks of the author’s age admired and strove to encourage.
zh: 我们发现的是作者那个时代的希腊人钦佩并努力鼓励的各种道德卓越的肖像画廊。
chunks: What we find is a sort
of portrait-gallery of the various types
of moral excellence which the Greeks
of the author’s age admired
and strove to encourage.

text: The most important is that of Justice or the Just Man, to which we may later return.
zh: 最重要的是正义或正义的人，我们稍后可能会回到这一点。
chunks: The most important is
that of Justice
or the Just Man,
to which we may later return.

text: Coercion and ignorance of relevant circumstances render acts involuntary and exempt their doer from responsibility, otherwise the act is voluntary and the agent responsible, choice or preference of what is done, and inner consent to the deed, are to be presumed.
chunks: Coercion and ignorance of relevant circumstances render acts involuntary
and exempt their doer from responsibility, otherwise the act is voluntary
and the agent responsible, choice or preference
of what is done, and inner consent to the deed,
are to be presumed.

text: Aristotle is unable wholly to avoid allusion to the metaphysical difficulties and what he does here say upon them is obscure and unsatisfactory.
zh: 亚里士多德无法完全避免提及形而上学的困难，他在这里所说的关于这些困难的内容是晦涩难懂的，不能令人满意。
chunks: Aristotle is unable wholly
to avoid allusion
to the metaphysical difficulties
and what he does here say
upon them is obscure and unsatisfactory.

text: Almost more than any other part of the work it has exercised influence upon mediaeval and modern thought upon the subject.
zh: 它对中世纪和现代关于这一主题的思想的影响几乎超过了该书的任何其他部分。
chunks: Almost more
than any other part
of the work it has exercised influence
upon mediaeval and modern thought
upon the subject.

text: It is the temper or habitual attitude demanded of the citizen for the due exercise of his functions as taking part in the administration of the civic community—as a member of the judicature and executive.
zh: 这是公民作为司法和行政部门的成员，参与公民社会管理，适当行使其职能所要求的脾气或习惯态度。
chunks: It is the temper
or habitual attitude demanded of the citizen
for the due exercise of his functions as taking part
in the administration of the civic community—
as a member of the judicature and executive.

text: The whole treatment is confused by the unhappy attempt to give a precise mathematical form to the principles of justice in the various fields distinguished.
zh: 整个处理过程因试图为不同领域的正义原则提供精确的数学形式而令人困惑。
chunks: The whole treatment is confused
by the unhappy attempt
to give a precise mathematical form
to the principles of justice
in the various fields distinguished.

text: It is this science which supplies the right rules of conduct Taking them as they emerge in and from practical experience, it formulates them more precisely and organises them into a system where they are all seen to converge upon happiness.
zh: 正是这门科学提供了正确的行为规则，它根据实践经验中出现的行为规则，将它们更精确地制定出来，并将它们组织成一个系统，在这个系统中，它们都被视为汇聚于幸福。
chunks: It is this science which supplies the right rules
of conduct Taking them
as they emerge in and from practical experience,
it formulates them more precisely and organises them into a system
where they are all seen to converge upon happiness.

text: This is the consummate form of reason applied to conduct, but there are minor forms of it, less independent or original, but nevertheless of great value, such as the power to think out the proper cause of policy in novel circumstances or the power to see the proper line of treatment to follow in a court of law.
chunks: This is the consummate form of reason applied to conduct,
but there are minor forms of it, less independent or original, but nevertheless of great value,
such as the power to think out the proper cause
of policy in novel circumstances or the power
to see the proper line of treatment to follow in a court of law.

text: This is Aristotle’s contribution to the discussion of the question, so central in Greek Moral Philosophy, of the relation of the intellectual and the passionate factors in conduct.
zh: 这是亚里士多德对问题讨论的贡献，这个问题是希腊道德哲学的核心问题，即行为中的理智因素和激情因素之间的关系。
chunks: This is Aristotle’s contribution to the discussion
of the question, so central
in Greek Moral Philosophy,
of the relation of the intellectual
and the passionate factors in conduct.

text: But beyond and above the practical ideal of what is best _for man_ begins to show itself another and still higher ideal—that of a life not distinctively human or in a narrow sense practical, yet capable of being participated in by man even under the actual circumstances of this world.
chunks: But beyond and above the practical ideal of what is best _for man_ begins
to show itself another and still higher ideal—
that of a life not distinctively human or in a narrow sense practical,
yet capable of being participated in by man even
under the actual circumstances of this world.

text: This condition was to the Greeks a matter of only too frequent experience, but it appeared to them peculiarly difficult to understand.
zh: 这种情况对于希腊人来说是屡见不鲜的事情，但对他们来说却显得特别难以理解。
chunks: This condition was
to the Greeks a matter
of only too frequent experience,
but it appeared
to them peculiarly difficult to understand.

text: Nevertheless the act may be the agent’s, and the will therefore divided against itself.
zh: 然而，该行为可能是代理人的，因此意志会与自身分裂。
chunks: Nevertheless the act may be the agent’s,
and the will therefore divided against itself.

text: He finds the source of the phenomenon in the nature of the desire for bodily pleasures, which is not irrational but has something rational in it.
zh: 他发现这一现象的根源在于对身体快乐的渴望的本质，这种渴望不是非理性的，而是有一定道理的。
chunks: He finds the source
of the phenomenon in the nature
of the desire for bodily pleasures,
which is not irrational
but has something rational in it.

text: The subject-matter of them was a favourite topic of ancient writers, and the treatment is smoother and more orderly than elsewhere in the _Ethics_.
zh: 它们的题材是古代作家最喜欢的话题，处理起来也比《伦理学》中的其他部分更加流畅和有序。
chunks: The subject-matter of them was a favourite topic
of ancient writers,
and the treatment is smoother
and more orderly than elsewhere
in the _Ethics_.

text: In Book VII. the antagonists were those who over-emphasised the irrationality or badness of Pleasure: here it is rather those who so exaggerate its value as to confuse or identify it with the good or Happiness.
chunks: In Book VII. the antagonists were those
who over-emphasised the irrationality or badness of Pleasure:
here it is rather those who so exaggerate its value
as to confuse or identify it
with the good or Happiness.

text: It is therefore always and in itself a good, but its value rises and falls with that of the activity with which it is conjoined, and which it intensifies and perfects.
zh: 因此，它本身总是一种善，但它的价值随着与其结合、强化和完善的活动的价值而升降。
chunks: It is therefore always and in itself a good,
but its value rises
and falls with that of the activity
with which it is conjoined,
and which it intensifies and perfects.

text: But on what sort of life is such activity possible?
zh: 但这样的活动在什么样的生活中是可能的呢？
chunks: But on what sort
of life is such activity possible?

text: True Happiness, great satisfaction, cannot be found by man in any form of “practical” life, no, not in the fullest and freest exercise possible of the “moral virtues,” not in the life of the citizen or of the great soldier or statesman.
zh: 人不可能在任何形式的“实际”生活中找到真正的幸福和极大的满足，不，不能在“道德美德”的最充分和最自由的实践中找到，也不能在公民、伟大士兵或政治家的生活中找到。
chunks: True Happiness, great satisfaction, cannot be found by man
in any form of “practical” life, no,
not in the fullest and freest exercise possible of the “moral virtues,
” not in the life of the citizen
or of the great soldier or statesman.

text: Happiness which human life can offer.
zh: 人类生活所能提供的幸福。
chunks: Happiness which human
life can offer.

text: The nobility of this ideal cannot be questioned; the conception of the end of man or a life lived for truth—of a life blissfully absorbed in the vision of truth—is a lofty and inspiring one.
zh: 这一理想的崇高性是不容质疑的。人类的终结或为真理而活的生命的概念——幸福地沉浸在真理的愿景中的生命——是一种崇高而鼓舞人心的概念。
chunks: The nobility of this ideal cannot be questioned;
the conception of the end of man or a life lived
for truth— of a life blissfully absorbed
in the vision of truth—
is a lofty and inspiring one.

text: The richness and variety of this Ideal ceaselessly invite, but as ceaselessly defy, our attempts to imprison it in a definite formula or portray it in detailed imagination.
zh: 这一理想的丰富性和多样性不断地邀请我们试图将其禁锢在一个明确的公式中或通过详细的想象来描绘它，但同时又不断地反抗我们的尝试。
chunks: The richness and variety of this Ideal ceaselessly invite,
but as ceaselessly defy,
our attempts to imprison it
in a definite formula
or portray it in detailed imagination.

text: The main drift of what he says here is that the most desirable thing would be that the best reason of the community should be embodied in its laws.
zh: 他在这里所说的主要内容是，最理想的事情是社会的最佳理由应该体现在其法律中。
chunks: The main drift of what he says here is
that the most desirable thing would be
that the best reason
of the community should be embodied
in its laws.

text: Philosophy of Human Conduct, merging at its beginning and end into metaphysics The result is a Moral Philosophy set against a background of Political Theory and general Philosophy.
zh: 人类行为哲学，从始至终都融入形而上学，其结果是一种以政治理论和一般哲学为背景的道德哲学。

merging at its beginning and end
into metaphysics The result is a Moral Philosophy set against a background
of Political Theory
and general Philosophy.

zh: 但这并不意味着道德哲学还没有多少东西可以从亚里士多德的《伦理学》中学习。
chunks: But this does not mean
that Moral Philosophy has not still much to learn from Aristotle’s _Ethics_.

to heart; —
he is a useless man.

zh: 现在，许多人显然是相当奴性的，选择了像野兽一样的生活：然而他们得到了一些考虑，因为许多伟人也有萨达纳帕勒斯的品味。
